page_title: EMP 1-1 UDI | Empoli v Udinese 25/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Arthur Atta (Udinese) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.

90+1' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) takes a good touch to control a cross on the edge of the box and fires a low drive towards the middle of the goal, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block his effort.
90+1' Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+1' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' The substitution is prepared. Brenner (Udinese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Florian Thauvin.
86' Udinese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

86' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Udinese.
85' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli).
83' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Liam Henderson is replaced by Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli).
82' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle and it's Keinan Davis (Udinese) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
82' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) passes the ball onto Keinan Davis, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
81' The game has come to an end for Sandi Lovric. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Arthur Atta (Udinese).
78' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) commits a rough foul. Livio Marinelli stops the game and makes a call.
76' 1 - 1 Gooal! Sandi Lovric takes over corner duties. Keinan Davis (Udinese) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the top right corner. 1:1.
76' Now Udinese have a corner.
75' The corner is swung in but Udinese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
74' Pietro Pellegri will be replaced by Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli).
73' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
72' The Udinese players can’t believe it after referee Livio Marinelli signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
72' There's a break in play and referee Livio Marinelli must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Udinese using VAR. This could be interesting!
72' Surely that's handball by one of the Udinese players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

72' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom right corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. Udinese earn a corner.
69' The foul by Florian Thauvin (Udinese) was seen by Livio Marinelli who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
66' Substitution. Giuseppe Pezzella will be replaced by Faustino Anjorin (Empoli).
66' We are about to witness a substitution. Ola Solbakken (Empoli) is replacing Lorenzo Colombo.
65' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
65' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
63' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) replaces Oier Zarraga.
61' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) tries to find Pietro Pellegri, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
60' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is penalised for a foul. Livio Marinelli had a clear view and blows his whistle.
58' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
56' 34:66 – the ratio of ball possession.
54' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

53' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Empoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle. Oier Zarraga (Udinese) commits a foul after dangerous play.
50' A pass by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
49' Udinese take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
49' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Udinese win a corner.
47' The resulting corner from Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is cleared by the defence.
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese. Udinese will take a corner kick.
46' Substitution. Hassane Kamara is replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
46' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lautaro Giannetti walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese).
46' The whistle blows and Livio Marinelli starts the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Dangerous play by Isaak Toure (Udinese). Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul.
44' A poor attempt from the edge of the box. Sandi Lovric (Udinese) dragged a first-time shot well wide of the right post.
43' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
38' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Udinese earn a free kick.
37' What was Liam Henderson (Empoli) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
36' A pass from Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is intercepted by Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach and the move breaks down.
34' Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) was too forceful with his tackle and Livio Marinelli interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

34' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
30' Maduka Okoye is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Liam Henderson (Empoli). Easy save!
27' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
26' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
26' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach, who smothers the ball.
23' 1 - 0 Pietro Pellegri (Empoli) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
22' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Maduka Okoye.
19' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
18' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
18' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Udinese.
15' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
13' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is caught offside!
10' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Liam Henderson (Empoli) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
8' Yellow card! It's like Hassane Kamara (Udinese) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Livio Marinelli agrees and books him.
8' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is penalised for holding. Livio Marinelli signals a set piece.
7' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Udinese keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
3' Empoli move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Udinese will kick-off.
Livio Marinelli will officiate today.
